competitor.name: Nobody Gets In
competitor.use: editing/visual/structure reference only; never copy characters, scripts, thumbnails

tools.image_generation: Code-drawn SVG illustrations (tools/draw.py, tools/draw2.py + tools/scenes_<topic>*.py) rendered by headless Chromium (Playwright). No AI image API configured.
tools.animation: Frame-by-frame SVG animation rendered by Chromium -> FFmpeg (tools/render.py). Line boil 8 fps, grain via ffmpeg noise filter.
tools.narration_tts: Kokoro v1.0 ONNX, local (voice am_michael). Model files: kokoro-v1.0.onnx + voices-v1.0.bin from github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx releases (model-files-v1.0).
tools.capcut: Not available in the cloud container; assets + SRT + timeline exported for manual import

commands.5_anim: python3 tools/render.py 01_PROJECTS/<project> anim [ids]   (run several processes with different id lists in parallel)

dependencies: pip install kokoro-onnx soundfile numpy playwright; system: ffmpeg, imagemagick, chromium (Playwright build)
storage: Git LFS for *.mp4 and *.wav (GitHub rejects single files > 100 MB on all plans). *_video_only.mp4 and *_audio_mix.wav are gitignored (regenerable).
